## Gleba Starter Factory

### Overview
- Small, easy to start, and generates all Gleba unique items, 100 SPM
- Mods level 2, and only Nauvis tech
- Will continue work forever as long as fruits are coming in
- 3 versions for this blueprint are included - one based on blue belts, one based on red belts and one that uses 4 planets tech

### How to use
1. Connect the factory to about 300/min from each fruit on any side (there are multiple entrances - connect to any). Connect it to some stone as well
2. Connect the factory to water
3. Add fuel to the heating towers until you've got initial power
4. Add 10-50 logistics bots
5. Put more than 1000 spoilage in the logistics network. The factory will create the initial nutrients and send it to all the modules using the bots
6. When everything is running, Place one penta egg to start science


### Notes
- **Important**: as the factory stores the seeds in buffer chests, seed requesters in the farms must check "Request from buffer chests" option
- I'm using this factory to to get enough stack inserters and biochambers to build [my second Gleba factory](https://factorioprints.com/view/-OFa_ZWh1hQypFqucMTy) so it will send alarm when it gathered enough. If you simply want a mini Gleba factory you can ignore/remove that alarm.
- If you want to speed up things: import iron plates, copper plates, and all 3 circuits to Gleba. You just need to bring it, the landing pad is already set to request it and the factory will use it without any additional action needed

#### 27/July/2025 Update (Version 1.6)
**New:**
- Added a 4th blueprint that uses 4 planets tech (foundries, EMPs). and mods level 2. For all of you that keeps Gleba as the last planet :)

#### 17/May/2025 Update (Version 1.5)
**New:**
- Added a second blueprint that uses red belts instead of blue belts, and AM2 instead of AM3, to allow you to go to Gleba earlier.
- Added a third blueprint with requester chests for all items needed by this blueprint.

#### 14/May/2025 Update (Version 1.4)
**Changes:**
- Replaced all efficient modules on biochambers with different modules, as biochambers unique feature is negative polution! The change improved production while reduced the resources needed by around 20%!
#### 9/April/2025 Update (Version 1.3)

**Fixes:**
- **Fix**: Added missing inserter to remove spoilage from the initial nutrient generator.  
- **Fix**: Biochamber buffer chest didn't request biochambers — now fixed.

**New:**
- Added buffer chests for inserter, fast inserter, and bulk inserter — each will keep 50 items.
- Added a buffer chest for stone, directly inserted into the landfill factory.
- Added a buffer chest for rocket launchers, limited to 5 items.
- Added a buffer chest for wood — the factory will use wood as fuel if heat towers are at low temperature.
- Added Jellynut and Yumako requester chests so any fruit in the system goes to the sushi belts.
- Added one extra steam turbine to provide additional power.

**Changes:**
- Switched input from constant combinators to display panels.
- Factory will now keep 1,000 artificial soil of each type (previously 500).
- Changed the temperature threshold for using rocket fuel from 700°C to 600°C — could go lower, but I prefer to play it safe.
- Disabled fuel usage when fuel stock is high — the only condition for using rocket fuel is now temperature.
- Biochamber production will no longer consume Pentapod eggs if other ingredients are missing.
- Science production will no longer consume Pentapod eggs if bioflux is missing.
- Reordered inserters in copper and iron factories for better belt management (items are now taken from belts before new items are added).
- Reduced the number of rockets required to build the factory by 2:
  - Replaced one fast splitter with an express splitter to avoid needing to bring fast splitters.
  - Removed a lamp to eliminate the need for a rocket carrying lamps.
</details>
